purpose: #TBD: under .tran uic an O card's v1, v2, i1 and i2 (or ic=v1,i1,v2,i2) are the line's state at t <= 0, as ngspice keeps them (ltraload.c:289-300), on the LC (tline.va), RLC and RC (ltra.va) paths. ESPice refuses them under uic (KNOWN GAP: the models cannot tell a uic start from the transient's .op); the build before ran them as zero, every value below 0.

oracle.derivation: ngspice 44.2 .meas values (7 significant digits); ngspice-45 prints the same lines. LC line: analytic too, a pure 5 ns delay between matched 50 ohm ends, so v(lo) = (v1 + Z0 i1)/2 = 0.75 V before 5 ns and 0 after, v(li) = 0 (v2 = i2 = 0): rtol 1e-6, atol 1e-9 V. RLC and RC lines: ngspice's convolution on its own grid (tmax = tstep = 0.1 ns). Rerun at tstep = tmax = 0.01 ns, the RLC values move at most 3.1e-5 relative (ro_7, ri_12): rtol 1e-3, ngspice's reltol, atol 1e-5 V. The RC values move up to 0.86% (co_1 0.1251945 -> 0.1262698, ci_1 0.6524887 -> 0.6509848): rtol 2e-2, atol 1e-4 V. Leaving the initial conditions out reads 0 V on every row but lo_7 and li_3.
